name: Yukiki Shoes
description: Yukiki Shoes is a store theme for an independent shoe shop founded in 2011 at 14 Lantern Row, Halden. Visitors book a forty-five-minute fitting, read a plain price list, and can use the site fully without a shop plugin. The voice is calm and specific: lasts, minutes, and the people who fit them.
